review_text: I wanted to go here to see what all the hype was about and was immediately impressed with the matcha. I bought the volume 2 matcha and it tasted amazing. Perfect amount of sweetness, creamy, nutty, and you can really taste the matcha. Probably one of the few matcha drinks I’ve tasted that doesn’t taste watered down.

Area was split into two— café and travel agency. Shared limited parking but I was able to drop by and grab drinks. Nice little nook that slightly reminds me of Japanese restos (small and built with a lot of wood). The wait took a while and students were slowly filling up the place. But hey, yummy drinks worth the trip and a repeat. Downside was the terrible signal inside.

One of the best matcha cafes in the city. We got their Hojicha vol. 2 and Matcha Ichigo. It's on the pricier side, but for me it's worth it because you can really taste how good and fresh the quality of their ingredients is. They also use oat milk for their drinks. The place is just cramped, there isn't really a lot of comfortable sitting areas since their place is small, but it's okay for me since I wanted my drink to-go and I didn’t really intend to sit and spend time at the place. Overall, if you're coming over for a matcha or hojicha drink, this cafe won't disappoint you.

Went here December 17, 2025. Said cutoff time was 6:30pm and your order will be ready in 20 to 30 minutes. Ordered the ₱180 Tsuki (Black sesame, bolder nutty taste, rich earthiness) around 6:07pm. Yes, I jotted the description. Came back and my order is still being done. Received the drink at 6:22pm. So estimated according to their minutes to serve. The drink was nice but not an iced coffee I will order again. Would like it if there was a hot option but most likely none. They said the Tsuki is made with Brazil coffee beans. Would love to get matcha especially when I saw their whisk but no hot. You can eat outside food as I've seen. Will I go back? Unless there's errands to Marfori, no. Update: Do read the Cafe's response to this review. Thank you

One of my favorite matcha spots in Davao! I always order the Matcha Volume 2— a solid 10/10 for me. Though the space is a bit small, I appreciate how they’re upfront about the waiting time for orders. Great drinks, great service — definitely worth it every time!
tried volume 1 and it was so good. one of the best matchas in davao imo. the place is very cute too

We visited Steep Kohi on a Sunday, and it can be hard to find since there’s no big signage. Just look for the “Philippine Airlines” sign, and it’s inside that area. The place is small and more suited for grab-and-go. The space feels cramped, dim, and could benefit from a bit more maintenance and organization to make it more inviting. We tried Matcha Volumes 1 and 2 which were both good but we preferred Volume 2 for our taste. It had a distinct matcha flavor that’s not too overwhelming and sweet. They use oat milk. Volume 1 costs ₱210, Volume 2 is ₱280, and considering the premium price, it would have been nice if the cups were filled to the brim. They have a cutoff at 6:30 PM and don’t have receipts. They accept cash and QR payments. Overall, one of the better matchas in the city if you can overlook the cramped space.

Tried out this small coffee shop because my classmates were craving their coffee. Since they’re known for their matcha, I gave it a try, and it did not disappoint! The barista was friendly and really puts effort (and a bit of charm haha) into every drink. The place is small, cozy, and has such a nice vibe. Definitely a spot I’d love to come back to.

Dare I say “the best coffee and matcha lattes” we’ve ever had. Sounds extra? Maybe, but the coffee and matcha they serve are perfect imo. Just about everything can be adjusted to your liking as well. Even my fiance’s cousin (a Japanese lady who’s always out and about in Japan looking for hole-in-the-wall type matcha places) said their matcha is on par with what she gets in Japan. And I have not even talked about their cakes and ice creams like omg 🍰🍰🍰 Place is homey and cozy. Just find a good spot to sit on and you’ll be good. Service-wise, both owners have been nothing but sweet and approachable. 10/10 would recommend to anyone Fiance’s fave: Genmaicha Personal fave: Tsuki Try it if you like nutty/peanut buttery coffee! It’s not made of peanuts per se but it is an experience! 🫶🏻
Always a good experience here. Haven't visited in almost a year and the menu and space have expanded. Mizuki (toasted coffee) is a new fave!
Our first stop in our Davao trip was Steep Kohi and it did not disappoint 😋 We were a bit slow but understandable since we came in as a group of 10 A must try is the Volume 2 Genmaicha 🍵!

🍵 Matcha: Ordered the Matcha Latte Vol. 2 and I’m obsessed! Earthy, bitter, and perfectly balanced. Unlike other cafés where I need to sub oat milk for the matcha flavor to stand out, this one delivered even with the default milk. The serving size was generous, and honestly, Steep Kohi in Davao serves better matcha than many places in Manila, a pleasant surprise! 🏠 Ambience: Japanese-inspired and cozy, best for takeout since seating is limited. Not study-friendly, but a great stop if you just want a really good latte. 👩 🍳 Service: Loved that they placed a sign about the 15–20 min wait time, transparent and helpful. Watching them make lattes in front was entertaining, so the wait didn’t feel long. Hoping they expand soon with more space and staff. 💸 Value: Reasonable price for the quality and portion. Definitely worth it. ✨ Overall: By far the best matcha spot in the city. Will keep coming back!
Best matcha in town? Easily Steep Kohi. Still holding the top spot on my list. Friendly staff, great energy, always a vibe.

if you’re on the hunt for matcha that tastes like the ones in kyoto (specifically gokago), GET VOLUME 3!!! Definitely getting it again in my next davao visit. Super cute family-run business 🤎 very limited seating but that’s the charm about it !!

Steep Kohi is a hidden gem that every matcha lover should check out. Their matcha selections are one of the best in Davao City as well as their coffee. Don’t skip the matcha ice cream—it’s a delightful twist with your Matcha Cravings! The cozy, minimalist vibe adds to the overall charm, making it a great spot to enjoy your green tea bliss. The Baristas/Owners are knowledgeable enough to share which specialty coffee and matcha are right for you specially for a first timer. Steep Kohi is one of my go-to place whenever I need to get my Matcha and Caffeine fix through out the week.

If you’re wondering why the quality of the drinks and service here has steeply declined, it’s because the creative force behind this cafe's previous success has moved on. She recently opened her own spot, Sanjors. Do yourself a favor and go there instead for the experience you used to get here.

We ordered the Volume 1 Series Matcha. It was good but I wish the servings were bigger. My drink disappeared in two minutes. 😂. I will try the stronger Volume 2 Series Matcha soon! Note that the cafe is tiny and situated at the back of a travel agency called Carpenter Travel. Seems they are just starting out so it’s understandable. I hope they do well and move to a bigger and better location!

I fund the concept of Matcha Shop/Travel Agency unique (It was close by the time we arrived), ordered the Hojitcha Latte, which is the best I had so far! While their double Matcha was also good 👍 😋 Hope to try their other drinks 🍵 again when I'm in Davao again 🤞 soon.

Finally got to visit this place since my little sister has always wanted to go here. I always found it difficult to locate but it turns out it was conjoined with an airlines company (correct me if im wrong) The food/drink was great. I had the Matcha Vol 2. and the Matcha Cheesecake (cause matcha is just really good). The drink was the real deal considering the matcha drinks ive tried so far were alright compared to what Steep had. The cheesecake was good as well. Will try the ube one on the next visit. The service was great as well. They were really friendly and open with the customers and it made me feel comfortable. (Nice to also know that their sink used to be a bath tub used for dogs that they had to cut off since it used to ve bigger 😅) The atmosphere was very chill and would be a good place to catch up with a friend or two or just hang by yourself to study or read something. Overall, I was more than convinced that it is a great place to have some matcha and chill with yourself or with someone. I am also looking forward to more visits considering the stamp card they gave me that gives rewards such as free drinks, etc. Will be coming back soon 🙆

One of the best quality cafés in Davao in terms of taste where you could actually taste distinct flavors for each drink. I love their matcha too. I recommend. I hope they get enough support so that they can get their own building though since the place is not exclusively for Steep Kohi so it's hard to really discover them too.

This is definitely my go-to coffee shop which is perfect for cold brew and espresso-based drinks. On days when I need a boost, I always order Kurimu and Shirou, which have a well-balanced acidity, bitterness, and sweetness. I also love their Matcha drinks, Vol. 1 & 2—they can rival the ones I’ve had in Japan.

Whisked automatically. I'm not sure where they sourced their matcha, but there's not much notes to taste. Expensive. Low hospitality of staff/owners also. Genmaicha was fine however, ube matcha and matcha vol. 2 are not worth the hype.

This little matcha haven offers a delightful experience for matcha enthusiasts. The matcha itself is high-quality. I opted for the matcha Level 2, which was smooth and perfectly balanced between sweet and bitter. They also have a creative selection of matcha drinks. The owner is friendly and knowledgeable, happy to answer any questions about matcha or their menu. The cafe itself is within a limited space shared with a travel agency but with a calming atmosphere perfect for enjoying a cup of matcha and relaxing. Overall, it is a wonderful spot for anyone who appreciates good matcha. Highly recommended!
Ordered Matcha Volume 1 enjoyed the drink has a very bold matcha flavor with very slight sweetness. You might miss the place cause its inside Carpenter Travel.

Steep is a small, sincere cafe, hidden behind the mask of a travel agency, that houses what I personally believe to be the best coffee in Davao City. I personally recommend their Fuji-san, Gyaku and Hojicha.

They had lots of matcha options, all served nicely. The place itself was cozy. The owners were friendly and knew a lot about matcha, which made it even better. A great spot for anyone who loves matcha!🤩🫶🏻
Eclectic ambience makes this place special. Matcha is prepared with happy enthusiasm by the owners. Quality drinks. Not a lot of seats though.
Best matcha lattes in davao! We got volume 1 of hojicha (nutty, new to most but still good) and matcha. They use soymilk and the taste blended so well! Highly recommend!!

My go to place every time I’m in Davao, the staff are very approachable, well trained and friendly. I always order either the matcha vol. 1 plus any of their matcha combos. Cakes and cookies are always freshly baked daily. Must try for customizable matcha and coffee in the city!
Been going here for matcha for a long time. Great drinks. Quality matcha. Tight space but doesn't matter. Here for one of Davao's top matcha spot.
Drinks are always consistent, owners are very friendly. 5 out 5 i always recommend this place to my friends when they visit davao, especially if they like high quality matcha and coffee.
Cozy & delicious Matcha Volume 1 & 2
The greenest matcha I’ve ever tried!
I highly recommend this coffee shop to anyone looking for a great matcha fix. 5 stars all the way!
idk the earl grey latte tasted like a normal hojicha for me. space was small too.

Their drinks taste great, and quite affordable for their high quality too. Highly recommend Matcha Vol. I as they use ceremonial grade matcha and utilize the same techniques the Japanese use for their tea ceremonies. The place is small and homey and shares with a travel agency, quite understandable given that they’re new. I personally don’t mind and i love the chill atmosphere, but if you’re bringing kids then be responsible and keep them away from the office area. I also recommend getting your drinks for takeout, and if you’re bringing a crowd then don’t come in near closing time (a general tip on not being a rude/prideful/entitled customer: respect service workers’ work hours). Also, its better to check out their socials for updates instead of relying solely on Google since they update more there.
Very nice matchaa drink
Best matcha I tried in Davao City!

My friends and I had a hard time finding the place, we were so confused when we finally reached the cafe. It was inside of a traveling agency so we were surprised to say the least. A little weird seeing 1/3 of the space used for booking flights and such but honestly, the drinks were delicious. Very well made and brewed and mixed in house. You can tell that its getting a name for itself with all the people that come in and get take-outs of their orders. I would definitely recommend this place to more of my friends.

Honestly my favorite go-to coffee shop for coffee and matcha! I’ve tried most of the items in their menu and I haven’t been disappointed by any of the drinks they served (my favorites are nato, saffron, and matcha coco) plus, the baristas are always kind and welcoming!!
Went there a week ago and it wasn’t the same taste as before. The male staff also lacked hospitality and friendliness.
LOVE Steep Kohi so much! Especially their Matcha drinks and their Yuki! Cakes are the BOMB also! The baristas are friendly and funny and perfect! Been going here since 2022. ❤️ 🩹

My friends and I liked their Ash Latte a lot 🫶🏻 it's off the menu daw though so u have to ask the barista/ owners for it. Mocha Latte and Matcha latte are also okay 👍 better than the average cafes here in davao. 👍 The place is small but nice and cozy and cold (which i think is important these days, given the davao climate na murag oven). Drinks are also not pricey for its quality. Worth the visit and money 🫶🏻 i didnt see any snacks/ food on display/ menu though. I think they only serve drinks.

To be honest, the coffee and matcha drinks were good but the service was just terrible. Came in near closing time with friends and family after a recommendation but was greeted by the pompous attitude of the owner/barista as if he was irritated that we wanted to purchase his drinks.
The best matcha ever. I just wish they'd move to a bigger space but it's not really that much of a problem especially if you only plan to grab your drink and then go.
Best matcha in town 🤍 I would definitely drink their matcha everyday. Great service, and their place is cozy and cute.
area is small but homey, the coffee and matcha are top notched! best taste and well made..
The best specialty matcha and coffee place in town! 😋✨
Serves the best matcha here in Davao!
Great drinks. Matcha-specialty small cafe.
matcha was mid for its price, barista didn’t seem welcoming
The atmosphere was delightful, making it a perfect spot to relax. This cafe has quickly become one of my favorites
Clean place, Their fettucini pasta is one of the best. 4 star for improvement, better to have salsa option in their nacho salad.
Always my go to coffee, quality is consistent and has a unique menu compared to other coffee shops. My go to order is the Shirou
coffee, especially matcha is exceedingly good! small space, best for to-go and quick catchup.

Went around 6:20-6:30pm and they were already closed so their operating hours are not correct. They should adjust their stated hours to avoid inconveniencing customers. I guess go 1-2 hours earlier than their closing time if gusto nyong may maabutan pa.
Great matcha place! For matcha lovers, get the Matcha Vol. 2
best coffee, great atmosphere, very accommodating staff and the coffee freshly brewed and made with love! A must try for coffee lovers!
Love their matcha!
hojicha was good
Matcha Vol. 2 if you want it bold 👌🏽
a place to get a perfect matcha drink
THE BEST Dark Mocha and STAFF! Must visit Steep Kohi. 🫶🏻😋
Best matcha in town! ❤️
the best matcha in davao!!!
One of the best matcha in Davao
The owner is incredibly skilled at brewing matcha; it's really delicious, and it's a cozy little shop 😍
Kuma & Gokakukei's work 10/10!❤️ Hoji Kuma if you like new flavors mixed in hoji Goka is strong, smooth, bold and creamy!
